title: Broaden the current-state assessment in 4.1 and Phase 1
requirements:
- Add work-practice methods (observation, workflow mapping)
- Add legal, privacy, security, semantic, data-quality and change-readiness assessments to Phase 1
- Note other foundational capabilities countries may assess
- Map existing systems to reference components after a capability and service inventory
- Extend the stakeholder list (subnational authorities, private providers, civil society, data-protection authorities, standards bodies) and call for context-specific analysis
- Assess actual use, accessibility and excluded populations
- Add analysis of existing data workflows alongside the systems inventory
- Assess real-world coverage, reliability and exclusion risk
